trial_court: learned Additional Judicial Magistrate No.8, Jaipur Metropolitan in Criminal Case No.54/2002
case_name: Suresh Kumar S/O Late Hardas Mal, By ... v. State Of Rajasthan Through P.P

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Suresh Kumar S/o Late Hardas Mal, By Caste Sindhi, Aged About 48 Years, R/o 116/147, Agarwal Farm Mansarovar, Jaipur — husband
parties.respondent_defendant: 1. State Of Rajasthan Through P.p., Rajasthan; 2. Smt. Mohini Devi @ Meena W/o Suresh D/o Moolchand By Caste Sindhi, Aged About 46 Years, R/o At Present Of 11/264, Malviya Nagar Jaipur (Rajasthan) — wife and State

facts_of_case: Parties have amicably settled their dispute. They have obtained divorce under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act and have re-married.

legal_principles.principle: Parties' amicable settlement of disputes can lead to quashing of proceedings.
legal_principles.held: In view of the fact that parties have amicably settled their dispute, I have considered the contentions.
cited_cases: B.S. Joshi & Ors. vs. State of Haryana & Anr., 2003 Cri.L.J. 2028

legal_principles.principle: Compounding of offence under Section 498-A IPC is possible in matrimonial disputes.
legal_principles.held: Apex Court in a matrimonial dispute had compounded the offence under Section 498-A IPC.
cited_cases: B.S. Joshi & Ors. vs. State of Haryana & Anr., 2003 Cri.L.J. 2028

outcome.final_order: Proceedings pending before learned Additional Judicial Magistrate No.8, Jaipur Metropolitan in Criminal Case No.54/2002 stand quashed.
